about: Plasma's desktop (folder view) containment, plasma-desktop-data 6.3.6 (Debian 13). VeltOS adds files/desktop/VeltOSDesktop.qml to it: the desktop's right-click menu is Windows 11's (View, Sort by, Refresh, Paste, New, Display settings, Personalize, Open in Terminal; Plasma's containment menu with Edit Mode and Add Widgets never opens), New > Folder / Text Document make the item at once and open its name for editing (Plasma asked in a dialog), Refresh blinks the icons, and the Recycle Bin, This PC and the VeltOS Store cannot be deleted, renamed or cut (their own small menu); every other file and folder gets Windows 11's menu with VeltOS' Properties window (KDE's dialog never opens). The Recycle Bin's icon shows whether it is full. The name box gets Windows 11's square corners. Everything else stays Plasma's.

replacements.why: the Windows 11 behaviour in one file of its own (menus, New, Refresh, protected icons)
the folder view hands its parts to VeltOSDesktop
the desktop's view takes right-clicks on empty space itself (Plasma left them to the containment, whose menu then opened)
right-click on the desktop opens Windows 11's menu instead of Plasma's containment menu
the Recycle Bin, This PC and the Store get their own menu without Delete (right-click and press-and-hold)
